thesis: 20-day breakout over 20.11 on spot ETH ETF, entered only on a retest of the level at 20.20 rather than chased at 20.61. Stop 19.30 sits below the breakout level with ~1 ATR buffer and is tighter than the 19.03 policy cap. Target 22.92 is the 2026-01-28 pivot, the first genuine overhead supply. Expected R 3.02. Counter-case: the move is a $648M short-liquidation squeeze into an 8-month high, and a single-source report puts October Fed hike odds above 50%; the retest entry is the answer, since a squeeze that never gives the level back simply does not fill.
